findings.title: Kalamazoo Behavioral Health Hospital — Medicare provider agreement termination scheduled for November 16, 2026
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Notice is hereby given that on November 16, 2026, the agreement between Kalamazoo Behavioral Health Hospital, 5802 S 9th St, Kalamazoo, MI 49009 and the Secretary of Health and Human Services, as a psychiatric hospital in the Medicare program, will be terminated.
findings.service_line: Inpatient psychiatric / behavioral health hospital services; Medicare reimbursement
findings.access_consequences: CMS notice states that Medicare will not make payment for inpatient hospital services for patients admitted on or after 2026-11-16; up to 30 days of covered services may continue for patients admitted earlier. A full hospital closure, current suspension of care, or patient transfers are NOT established by the notice.
findings.affected_population: Medicare beneficiaries considering admission to Kalamazoo Behavioral Health Hospital on or after November 16, 2026, and patients admitted earlier whose reimbursement may be affected; number unknown.
findings.temporal_note: Late-discovered October 30 CMS public notice, not a newly announced or executed November 3 service closure. Found by examining the official PDF in this watch. Duplicate check against the immediately previous and selected November 2 watch findings found no matching prior watch finding; full authoritative production deduplication remains unverified.
findings.source_type_note: CMS index categorizes the facility as PRTF, while the signed notice describes the participating provider as a psychiatric hospital; the signed notice controls the reimbursement-effect description.
